page: Amazon Web Services m7i.48xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 192 vCPUs consisting of 96 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core using dedicated Intel Xeon 8488C processors running at 3.2 GHz. The CPU architecture is x86_64, supported by 105 MB of L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPUs, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 169765.72 and a PassMark CPU score of 123573.37. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching top-tier speeds of 13862.96 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 455.06 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. The processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions, contribute to top-tier performance in PassMark extended instructions and encryption benchmarks.

This instance is designed for large-scale general-purpose workloads, high-throughput database operations, and CPU-based machine learning. In testing, it achieved 182.23 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a static web serving throughput of 128.6 GB/sec. For LLM inference, it processes prompts at 39.82 tokens per second on a 70B model. Given its high resource density and lack of bundled local storage, it offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive and highly parallelized compute tasks that rely on network-attached storage.
